title: Signal: Content-Security-Policy script-src trusts every subdomain of an origin
scope: One policy whose script-src carries a `*.domain` source.
limitations: One header value and one directive. The rule reports the wildcard form; it cannot tell which subdomains exist or whether any of them is presently attacker-influenced.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' *.example.com
default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src https://*.cdn.example.com

fpNotes: A wildcard for a domain whose every subdomain is genuinely trusted is still reported; the rule reports the form, and the reviewer decides whether that trust is deliberate.
